nodes.summary: For every natural number $k$, the Jordan totient function $J_k$ is multiplicative: $J_k(1) = 1$, and $J_k(mn) = J_k(m) J_k(n)$ for all coprime natural numbers $m$ and $n$.
nodes.title: Jordan's totient function is multiplicative

nodes.summary: For every natural number $k$, the Jordan totient function satisfies $J_k(1) = 1$.
nodes.title: Jordan's totient at one

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, $J_1(n) = \varphi(n)$, where $J_1$ is the Jordan totient function $J_k$ with $k = 1$ and $\varphi$ is Euler's totient function; at $n = 0$ both sides are $0$.
nodes.title: Jordan's totient of order one is Euler's totient

nodes.summary: For every natural number $k$, every prime $p$ and every integer $e \ge 1$, the Jordan totient function satisfies $J_k(p^e) = p^{k(e-1)}(p^k - 1)$.
nodes.title: Jordan's totient at prime powers

nodes.summary: For every natural number $k$ and every prime $p$, the Jordan totient function satisfies $J_k(p) = p^k - 1$.
nodes.title: Jordan's totient at primes

nodes.summary: For every natural number $k$, the Jordan totient function satisfies $J_k(0) = 0$; this is the convention extending $J_k$ to $0$.
nodes.title: Jordan's totient at zero

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
